title: Relay queue close refusal after files changed behind the…
what: lib/relay_queue.py:987: LOW: F2 relay queue close refusal after files changed behind the check says only 'check the fix again', not the gate
why: Found outside the change by the review of wt/merge-msg, 24 Oct: same gap the refused-merge item fixed in the merge hook, left in relay queue done. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: A fix branch with a check mark of commit C (Q1 MET), then lib/late.py committed after C.
`relay queue close <slug>` refuses: "after the check of C, lib/late.py changed, which is not inert: check the fix again".
The person reruns the checker, and the merge then refuses for a stale gate. Same pattern the queue item fixed in the
merge hook: the text should name both steps, "...; run relay gate, then delegate:checker".
pass_cases: 1. The case above -> check_refusal(...) contains "lib/late.py" and "run relay gate, then delegate:checker".
2. No mark on the branch -> unchanged "no check of this fix: run delegate:checker on the branch's head, then close '<slug>'"
(or extended to name the gate the same way).
3. Mark with Q1 MET and nothing non-inert after it -> check_refusal returns None (test at test_merge_train.py:405 keeps passing).
